usage: The word '玄關' refers to the entrance hall or foyer of a house or apartment.
It is used to describe the space right inside the main door where people often take off their shoes or hang coats.
You can use '玄關' in everyday conversations when talking about your home layout or when giving directions within a house.
In sentences, '玄關' usually acts as a noun and can be combined with verbs like '放' (to put) or '整理' (to organize).
It can also be used metaphorically to mean the beginning or entrance of any place or space.
